fields.label: Title
fields.description: e.g. GMO Allocation, Sales & Marketing Allocation

fields.label: Driver Label
fields.description: What the pro-rata is based on — Head count, Leads count, Floor area, ...

fields.label: Pool Source
fields.description: report_row: the pool is a row of an existing report, run with one cost centre filter — the number the P&L already shows. flag: read from account flags. manual: entered per month.

fields.label: Source Report
fields.description: The report the pool is read from.

fields.label: Source Row
fields.description: Key of the row to read, e.g. total_expenses.

fields.label: Source Cost Center
fields.description: The report is run with this single cost centre filter. This is also the cost centre credited back when Credit Back is on.

fields.label: Pool Flag
fields.description: The account flag holding the total pool cost for this allocation.

fields.label: Pool Sign
fields.description: Expenses are stored positive; invert if the flag returns a credit balance.

fields.label: Driver Source
fields.description: manual: typed into the grid. employee_headcount: counted from Employee records as of each month.

fields.label: Cost Centre From
fields.description: payroll_cost_center reads the field on Employee. department_map uses the table below.

fields.label: Count Statuses
fields.description: Comma-separated Employee statuses to count. Default Active. An employee with a relieving date is still counted in the months before they left, whatever their status is today.

fields.label: Lead → Cost Centre Field
fields.description: Fieldname on Lead that links to Cost Center. On this site that is business_line.

fields.label: Count assigned leads only
fields.description: Only leads that have actually been assigned to someone. Assignment means a ToDo record — lead_owner defaults to whoever created the lead, so it is not evidence of assignment.

fields.label: Which Date Counts
fields.options:
assignment
custom_creat_date
creation
date
qualified_on
won_or_lost_date
fields.description: Which date places a lead in a month. 'assignment' uses when the lead was first assigned, read from ToDo — not the due date on it.

fields.label: Exclude Statuses
fields.description: Comma-separated Lead statuses to leave out, e.g. Do Not Contact. Blank counts every status.

fields.label: Split across Business Lead Units
fields.description: When the Business Lead Unit table is filled, count the lead once per unit instead of once on its business line.

fields.label: Allocation Formula
fields.description: Evaluated once per cost centre per month. Variables: pool, amount_total, distributable, driver, driver_total, month, year. Functions: IF ROUND ABS MIN MAX. driver_total is the sum of the driver table only — never a company-wide figure.

fields.label: Credit the source cost centre
fields.description: On: the source cost centre is credited with everything it gave away, so it nets to zero and the consolidated total is unchanged. Off: receiving cost centres are charged and the source keeps its cost, which double-counts at company level unless handled in the report formula.

fields.label: Credit To
fields.description: Defaults to the source cost centre when left blank.
